differential.name: End-stage renal disease due to diabetic nephropathy
differential.rationale: Advanced CKD (stage 4) with proteinuria, diabetes, hypertension, and dialysis dependence points to diabetic ESRD.

differential.name: Anemia of chronic kidney disease
differential.rationale: Low albumin and known CKD with anemia flag suggest reduced erythropoietin production.

differential.name: Dyslipidemia (hypertriglyceridemia & elevated LDL)
differential.rationale: Metabolic syndrome, obesity, and lipid panel showing high total/LDL cholesterol and low HDL.

differential.name: Non‑alcoholic fatty liver disease
differential.rationale: Mild ALT elevation with normal AST in a diabetic, obese patient is typical for NAFLD.

differential.name: Metabolic acidosis secondary to chronic kidney disease
differential.rationale: Low serum CO₂ (21 mmol/L) with CKD stage 4 indicates impaired acid excretion.
